artworks.title: Sketches of Heads, Including One of Chester Dale
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Chester Dale Collection
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch depicting a group of people, mainly of their upper bodies and heads. The individuals are illustrated in a variety of positions, some facing forward, others in profile, and some slightly turned to the side. The facial features are simple and somewhat exaggerated, with distinct outlines and details. There is a woman with a voluminous updo and a man with a prominent mustache, while another figure is wearing round glasses. The clothing appears minimalistic but suggests formal attire for some, with collared shirts and what might resemble a dress with ruffles. Several figures have accessories, such as hats. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Sketches of Three Female Heads [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Chester Dale Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of three individuals. The central figure is detailed, facing forward with distinctive facial features and short, dark hair. They wear earrings and a garment with thin straps. The person on the left has a bun-like hairstyle and outline of clothing on the shoulders. The person on the right is minimally sketched with basic features. The sketch is done in pencil on a plain background with visible texture.

artworks.title: Elsie Speicher [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Chester Dale Collection
artworks.description: The sketch shows an upper portion of a woman's body, focusing on her torso and head. The woman is positioned slightly sideways, with her head tilted downwards. Her facial features are minimally detailed, with closed eyes and suggested lips. Her hair is styled in a bun. She is wearing a dress with a scoop neckline and a shawl or garment covering her shoulders. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Bacchanalian Scene with Satyrs and a Maenad
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This print depicts a group of people and creatures in a scene together. In the center, a nude woman sits on the ground, one elbow resting on a low bench or surface behind her. On the left, a human-like creature with long horns and pointed ears is pressed close against her, one hand on her chin and one curved around her body to grab her breast. The woman looks to the right, away from the creature, a neutral expression on her face. One of her hands reaches up to touch the chest of another horned creature on the left. This creature is standing, revealing goat-like legs. One of its hands covers its face, while the other holds a plate or dish upwards. A cloth seems to drift upward from its shoulders. On the far left, another creature is seated or reclining, looking towards the center. This creature has shorter horns. On the right, behind the woman, is a small cherub-like creature with a bird perched on its hand. There is a vase near the bottom right corner and a tall tree with twisting vines and bunches of fruit behind the central couple. The background is made of thin diagonal lines stretching from the top left corner to the bottom right. A small stream of water appears to flow across the ground.

artworks.title: Christ Preaching (The Hundred Guilder Print)
artworks.artist: Léopold Flameng, after Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.medium: etching on chine collé on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Miss Alice Hall Kerr
artworks.description: Printed with black lines and deep, velvety shading on tan-colored paper, a man, Jesus, stands at the center of a crowd of more than two dozen people, mostly adults and a few children, in this horizontal etching and drypoint. Jesus is left of center. He stands facing us, but he turns his head to look to our left. Rays of light emanate from behind his head against the towering cave opening that swallows the right two-thirds of the scene. Jesus’s curly hair falls long over his shoulders, and he holds both hands out. His eyes are lightly incised, giving them an almost blurred look. A crowd of people lie or kneel deep in shadow to our right. Some use crutches or walking sticks, and some are on carts. All the people appear to have pale skin except for one with darker-toned skin to the right in this gathering. That person has a rounded nose, full lips, and wears an earring that gleams brightly in the deep shadows. A camel stands at the far side of this group under an arched opening. The people standing and one person sitting close to Jesus to the left are fully shaded, and those farther left are lightly outlined and sparsely shaded so they appear to be much lighter on the white paper. Close to Jesus are a woman holding a baby, a seated, clean-shaven young man, and several bearded men. Most of those who are along the left edge of the sheet wear turbans or floppy caps.

artworks.title: Landscape No. 162 from "Liber Veritatis"
artworks.medium: mezzotint and etching in brown
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Miss Alice Hall Kerr
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene from an elevated perspective. The horizon includes distant hills and a large building. The linework is detailed, with cross-hatching defining trees and the structure. The color palette is primarily sepia-toned. A figure sits on the ground amidst bushes and trees, with small figures and boats visible on water in the distance. The sky is mostly clear with minimal cloud detail.

artworks.title: Cupid Riding a Snail over Fungus Vegetation
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.creditLine: Print Purchase Fund (Rosenwald Collection)
artworks.description: The image contains a complex network of lines and curves forming an abstract composition. In the center, a figure is woven with elements like leaves, feathers, and a snail shell. The design incorporates natural motifs such as plants and rocks, blending human and natural elements in an abstract narrative.

artworks.title: Vegetable Market at Pontoise (Marché aux légumes á Pontoise)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint (zinc)
artworks.creditLine: Print Purchase Fund (Rosenwald Collection)

artworks.title: The Temptation
artworks.medium: watercolor
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: This is a painting of a scene featuring a tree, animals, and different activities. The painting shows a landscape with a large tree at the center, surrounded by animals. Fruits are on its branches, and a snake is wrapped around its trunk. Various animals are around the tree, including a peacock, sheep, lion, horse, rabbit, birds, and a turkey. There are plants, a river, and the setting seems to convey a story.

artworks.title: Lolotte and Werther
artworks.medium: watercolor; the picture on the wall is an original engraving entitled "Winter,"  pasted in a simulated frame
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image displays two adults and a child. A woman is seated at a piano looking left, while a man sits to her right, leaning on a table and looking at her. The woman has light features, styled hair with a blue ribbon, and wears a blue and white dress. The man has light skin, a white wig, and wears a red coat over a blue waistcoat. The child, standing between them, has dark hair, wears a yellow gown, and holds a doll. A large window shows greenery, and a painting of a winter scene hangs on the wall. The room has a diamond-patterned carpet.

artworks.title: Baptismal Wish for Catarina Titzlir
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and transparent and opaque watercolor on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: This is a painting of a decorative folk art piece featuring two stylized figures and German script. The image shows two stylized figures positioned on either side of ornate, old-fashioned German script. The figure on the left appears to be dressed in a period costume, complete with a hat and an overcoat with lace detailing, while the figure on the right is adorned in a detailed dress with heart motifs and an apron. Above the write-up and between the figures, there is a bird with outstretched wings decorated with intricate patterns.

artworks.title: Reward of Merit for Anna Gerhard
artworks.medium: pen and iron gall ink with red, green, and yellow wash and pricking around the flower
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: This is a painting of two red unicorns facing each other with a large symmetrical flower between them. The unicorns are standing on their hind legs with their front legs raised. Their bodies are covered with a pattern of black dots, and they have long manes and tails. In the center is a flower with alternating red and green petals. Below the scene is a German inscription in ornate script. The painting is dated 1787 and has decorative borders.

artworks.title: The Prodigal Son Taking Leave of His Father
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: This is a painting of an interior scene featuring a dog and bird alongside various figures in elaborate dress. The room showcases four interacting figures, with a central figure in bright clothing shaking hands with another. A dog stands to the side and a parrot is perched inside a decorative cage. The room is adorned with patterned fabrics and richly colored decor, such as drapes and banners, enhancing the lively ambiance. The style is early American folk art.

artworks.title: The Prodigal Son Wasted His Substance
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of people gathered around a table in an interior scene. The painting depicts figures engaged in some form of social interaction, dressed in historical or theatrical costumes with bright colors and ornate details. The table has a striped cloth and various objects like a wine bottle and glasses. The room has decorative elements such as a large, red drapery in the upper corner and a framed mirror or painting on the wall. The setting suggests a space for leisure and merriment. The style is naive and folk-like, with bold outlines and vibrant colors. This is in the style of an early American or folk artist.

artworks.title: The Prodigal Son in Misery
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting on a stylized hill, positioned sideways but with the upper body slightly facing the viewer. The person has a distinct facial expression, with a defined jawline, wide eyes, and dark, voluminous hair styled in waves. They are wearing a red garment with a shawl over their shoulders and a yellow lower garment. In their left hand, they hold a small bundle. The background features a large tree with a thick trunk and broad, dark leaves. Two figures are near a house with a colorful patchwork roof on the right. In the distance, there is another small figure in an open area, possibly a field. The lower part of the image shows abstract animal depictions near water.

artworks.title: The Prodigal Son Reclaimed
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people in a stylized drawing. In the foreground, two figures are prominently featured, with one person kneeling while the other stands. The kneeling person is depicted in profile, wearing a brown jacket, light-colored pants, and black shoes, while the standing figure wears a large brown coat with light blue pants and is extending an arm toward the kneeling individual. Both figures have simplified facial features and gray hair, with the standing person donning a black hat. In the background, additional figures are present, displaying simplified faces and wearing various headgear, including hats and a turban. They are dressed in brightly colored clothes. The background displays abstract shapes in striking orange against a white and blue sky. In the far left, a small, unclothed figure resembling a cherub is depicted holding a heart in a decorative setting. Some handwritten text is present at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: The Purple Jack Daw (Gracula Quiscula)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of a purple bird perched on a rock. The image depicts a bird with dark plumage standing on a small, rocky mound scattered with patches of greenery. The bird's beak is open, and its eye is highlighted. The brushstrokes illustrate the texture of its feathers, while the rock beneath is shaded in warm earth tones, accentuated by small areas of plant life sprouting around it. The background is a plain, light color, allowing focus on the detailed rendering of the bird itself.

artworks.title: The Ground Dove (Columba passerina)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bird and a flowering plant. The drawing features a small bird labeled as "The Ground Dove," beneath an illustration of a botanical subject. The plant is adorned with leaves, flowers, and seed pods. The composition resembles classic botanical illustrations, with precise attention to detail. The accompanying text suggests a scientific context, enhancing the educational aim of the drawing.

artworks.title: The Pied-billed Dobchick (Colymbus podiceps)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of a bird with webbed feet, identified as "Podiceps," likely a type of grebe, depicted in water. The image portrays the bird from a side angle, with its body mostly round and head elegantly curved towards its back, as it sits on a blue patch representing water. The bird's plumage is shown in shades of brown with intricate detailing. The feet are detailed with lines suggesting a scale-like texture, extending out behind the bird. This painting is in the style of naturalist illustrations of the 18th and 19th centuries.

artworks.title: The Black Muray (Muraenae helenae varietas)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an eel entwined with a plant resembling seaweed or coral. The image depicts the elongated body of the eel with a textured surface. The eel is coiled around and through several tall, slender branches of a plant that resembles underwater flora. The colors are subdued, with earthy tones highlighting the plant life and a darker shade for the eel. The composition is simple yet detailed, emphasizing the natural interaction between the eel and its surrounding environment.

artworks.title: The Sucking Fish (Echeneis Naucratis)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a plant with a fish. The drawing includes long, narrow green leaves with small red flowers growing on a branch, accompanied by a remora fish at the bottom. The leaves are arranged in an alternating pattern. The name "Phylanthos" is noted at the top, while "Remora" is labeled beneath the fish. The style suggests a scientific illustration emphasizing the botanical and biological details of both the plant and the fish, showcasing fine line work and realistic coloring.

artworks.title: The Red Mottled Rock-crab (Cancer grapsus)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two different crab species. The top half of the drawing features a pagurid crab, identified as "Pagurus Maculatus," showcasing its red claws and articulated, speckled limbs. The bottom half displays a depiction of another crab species labeled "Cancer chelis crassissimis," characterized by its robust claws and heavily textured carapace. Both species are illustrated with emphasis on the textures and patterns found on their shells and pincers.

artworks.title: The Logger-head Turtle (Testudo Cavanna)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a turtle. The image shows a turtle with a detailed texture of its shell and skin, positioned horizontally across the middle of the composition. The turtle appears to be swimming or floating in a textured blue surface representing water. Below the water, there is the text "Testudo &c." printed in fine script. The drawing emphasizes the turtle's features, such as its segmented limbs, scaly body, and shell patterns.

artworks.title: The Coach-Whip Snake (Coluber flagellum)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows a long, coiled snake and a flowering plant. The snake is brown with a pattern, a forked tongue, and a red eye. The plant has a stem with a red flower and green leaves. The snake is positioned diagonally, weaving around the plant's stem with its head in the top left and tail in the bottom left. The plant is in the bottom right corner against a light beige background.
